channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dirk Nowitzki | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dirk Nowitzki from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
He's joined by his brothers Thanasis and Alex, who played together in the latest Bucks game, and he congratulates them, beaming with pride, but also looking worn out and tired.) Antetokounmpo:

“This is why you have conversations with all-time greats like KG (Kevin Garnett). Dirk (Nowitzki) was in the same position, and chose to stay. We’ll see. We’ll see what’s going to happen.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Garnett, Apr 7, 2026. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“We were with Dirk Nowitzki for 21 years, and the last three years were out of pure respect,”

Donnie Nelson on Dirk Nowitzki, Jul 5, 2025. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Luka Doncic on Dirk Nowitzki attending his Lakers debut in person:

“I’ve always looked up to him. A great mentor. For him to fly all the way from Dallas, it was amazing. I really, really appreciated it.”

Luka Doncic on Dirk Nowitzki, Feb 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Steve Nash, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“But it’s good, at the end of the day Dirk [Nowitzki] and Steve [Nash] know I wasn’t healthy enough to play. I wanted to be more with my kids and it was an easy decision. I miss games and locker rooms, but I don’t miss practices. Especially in Miami, where they were tough. But I wouldn’t change it, I’m satisfied with my career, Right now I’m happy, no pain anymore”

Goran Dragic on Steve Nash, Dirk Nowitzki, Aug 24, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“Everyone has a right to their opinion… But yeah, he can shoot it… Dirk [Nowitzki] was the first to start that. So I think Dirk would definitely have something to say.”

Jason Kidd on Dirk Nowitzki, May 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Lauri Markkanen:

“He’s the closest thing that I've seen to Nowitzki in terms of a seven footer that can really stretch the game out and play inside.”

Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Lauri Markkanen, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Stephen Curry:

“I am blessed to know and hope that no matter how many years I do play, playing for one franchise and being a part of that group of the legends that have accomplished that feat and won at the highest level and all that. I don’t ever take that for granted either. You got the Kobe [Bryant]’s, the Magic [Johnson]’s, Dirk [Nowitzki], Tim Duncan, those guys helped establish a culture, won, did it with a lot of different roster combinations and different parts in their career.”

Stephen Curry on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Aug 29, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Shane Larkin on Vince Carter, Dirk Nowitzki, Shawn Marion
item.description:
“I told him my biggest regret was that when I went to the NBA I kind of thought like, 'Oh, now I'm playing with Vince Carter, Shawn Marion, Dirk Nowitzki, like, I got to get them the ball and get out of the way. Like they're the All-Stars, they're the superstars, they've been in the league for 12, 15 or 20 years and I'm just this 20-year-old rookie coming out first, second, and third year playing with guys in Dallas, New York, and Brooklyn.' And I never really felt like I took advantage of the opportunity to just be me, and that's what I told him he doesn't want to feel,”

Shane Larkin on Vince Carter, Dirk Nowitzki, Shawn Marion, Jul 20, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dirk Nowitzki, DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Casey on Bogey as potential All-Star:

“I hope people don’t look at our record as a rebuilding team & punish him. To me, Bogey’s an All-Star. I’ve coached a lot of offensive players in my career — Nowitzki, DeRozan, Kevin Garnett. Offensively, he’s right up there with those guys.”

Dwane Casey on Dirk Nowitzki, DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Garnett, Dec 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Kobe Bryant, Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Kristaps Porzingis was dubbed the 'Unicorn' by Durant early in his career because he was especially unique, but now there are a few players with the same pedigree following in his footsteps.

“Dirk Nowitzki was a superstar and of course he made the style of play much more acceptable by what he was doing and for everyone else after him. I grew up watching him, I grew up watching Pau Gasol and Kobe [Bryant],”

Kristaps Porzingis on Kobe Bryant, Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki, Oct 3, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Following the Game 7 victory, Doncic shared an embrace with Nowitzki as the remaining Suns fans in Phoenix's Footprint Center booed them.

“(Nowitzki) was just happy. I think it gives everyone on this team a lot of confidence when you see Dirk sitting courtside (even) on away games,”

Luka Doncic on Dirk Nowitzki, May 16, 2022. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“Taking something that you didn’t think was as serious — and it was serious from the standpoint of sickness and health— and just being a young kid and making fun of something. Trying to get a laugh or do something to the camera. “I don’t even like looking at the clip. I would tell my son not to do something like that. It wasn’t anything personal [toward Nowitzki]; it was just in the moment of the media trying to come up with stories. Kind of making fun of it, ‘Okay, he’s sick, all right; what other excuse are you going to give him?’ It became a big thing. Do you mean to do something like that in the moment? Probably not, but you did it. You take it on the chin and move on.”

Dwyane Wade on Dirk Nowitzki, Mar 8, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns on the flagrant foul:

“I've never seen it in basketball before. I've never seen it in the NBA... All I'll say is Dirk Nowitzki got put on the floor for the same shot.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Dirk Nowitzki, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
.@Mark Cuban on @Dirk Nowitzki's advisor role and his reaction to having him officially back in the Mavs' fold:

“Dirk is going to be involved in the entire process of our finding a GM and coach. His insights and input are of course invaluable and I'm excited that he is involved.”

Mark Cuban on Dirk Nowitzki, Jun 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Steve Nash on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Steve Nash on Dirk Nowitzki potentially getting back into basketball:

“I don't know that he's ready to jump back in just yet.”

Steve Nash on Dirk Nowitzki, Jun 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Corey Brewer on Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Tyson Chandler, Shawn Marion, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson
item.description:
Corey Brewer:

“So for us, it was like 'alright, they're disrespecting us. And you gotta realize, we had a lot of great players on that team. We had Shawn Marion, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson, Brandon Haywood. We had Tyson Chandler, the big anchor back there. We had a good team, so we felt disrespected and I think that's what we took into the Finals. If you're going to disrespect us, we're going to show you that we're not to be disrespected.”

Corey Brewer on Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Tyson Chandler, Shawn Marion, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson, Apr 2, 2021. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Dirk Nowitzki, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“To leave a team, that's a hard thing to do, especially if you're a guy like him. Just think about Dirk Nowitzki. He was Dallas all the way, (and) it seems like Giannis is all the way (with Milwaukee). “But,”

Brian Scalabrine on Dirk Nowitzki, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 2, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Spencer Dinwiddie on Kevin Durant:

“At 80%, he's Dirk Nowitzki. At 100%, he's the best scorer of all-time. And anywhere in between, he's still a top-three small forward in the league... I don't see a world where he's not one of the elite players in the NBA when he comes back.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Durant, May 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Tony Parker on Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“It had a huge impact in Europe. If you see interviews that I did or Dirk [Nowitzki] or Pau Gasol, we all were affected by the Dream Team,”

Tony Parker on Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki, May 7, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“And probably each organization has their own way of doing things, their own culture, and arriving here it was a transition year. Dirk [Nowitzki] was finishing his career and we were looking into the future, into the next season, and this is our first year together. And I feel like we’re just getting started. And we have the confidence that we have the right people around us that we can go far.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Dirk Nowitzki, Apr 9, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Devin Booker on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Larry Fitzgerald
item.description:
“I always had respect for those guys — Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki,Larry Fitzgerald — to do it all in one town and go through all the ups and downs in one city and have the community still embrace you. “It’s unbelievable. That’s why he’s Larry the Legend. That’s why the reputation he has, that’s going to stay here forever in Phoenix.”

Devin Booker on Kobe Bryant, Dirk Nowitzki, Larry Fitzgerald, Jan 24, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on the 2006 playoff series with Mavericks and Nowitzki's 3-point play that forced overtime after Manu fouled him:

“That was a great moment for him. He got touched by a feather … and he knows it.”

Gregg Popovich on Dirk Nowitzki, Apr 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Charles Barkley on Dirk Nowitzki at an exhibition in Germany:

“I’m like, who is this guy here? So I say, who the heck are you? And he told me he’s Dirk Nowitzki and he said: I’m going in the army. I said, right, you’re 7-feet tall. You’re not going into the army.”

Charles Barkley on Dirk Nowitzki, Apr 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Charles Barkley:

“Let me say this about Dirk Nowitzki: He’s the nicest man ever. Hey, hey ... it’s been an honor and a privilege to watch you. Enjoy the rest of your life.”

Charles Barkley on Dirk Nowitzki, Apr 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Jazz coachQuin Snyder on Dirk Nowitzki:

“Watching him throughout the course of his career you feel you’ve been treated.”

Quin Snyder on Dirk Nowitzki, Feb 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Adam Silver on Dwyane Wade, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Silver:

“In the case of Dwyane Wade, has already announced this was going to be his last season...in the case of Dirk Nowitzki, I had seen him painfully running up and down the court which made it clear this would be his last season”

Adam Silver on Dwyane Wade, Dirk Nowitzki, Feb 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @MadelynBurke.

item.title: Jose Juan Barea on Dirk Nowitzki, Kristaps Porzingis, Luka Doncic
item.description:
“They’ve seen it before. He’s never going to be as good as No. 41 (Dirk Nowitzki). But if it gets close, we’re good. There’s going to be people that want to come play with them (Porzingis and Doncic). And Hardaway is going to help next to those two. He’s athletic and fast.”

Jose Juan Barea on Dirk Nowitzki, Kristaps Porzingis, Luka Doncic, Feb 1, 2019. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, who had his best outing so far this season with 7 points, 1 rebound, 1 assist and 2 blocks:

“Dirk is fighting through a lot to be on the court and compete. I gain more respect for him every day. He helped us out there tonight a lot.”

Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Dec 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Giannis on Dirk Nowitzki:

“He inspired me. He still inspires me. I watched a lot of Dirk Nowitzki clips. I followed his story... He's one the guys that set the path for us [European players]. (...)He just makes us [Europeans] believe more in our dreams.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Dirk Nowitzki, Dec 25, 2018. Source: reddit.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on his team:

“I like the group, I like the roster. The fact that we don’t have Dirk (Nowitzki) and (Harrison) Barnes is a big challenge tonight(against Phoenix). We’re going to play our brand of basketball and we’re going to have a chance to win some games.”

Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Harrison Barnes, Oct 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.
